title: Equivalence of categories of bivariant K-theory for C*-algebras over topological spaces via reflection functors
summary: In this paper, for various pairs of topological spaces $X$ and $Y$, we introduce an analogue of the Bernšteĭn-Gel'fand-Ponomarev reflection functors between the categories of C*-algebras over $X$ and $Y$. We prove that these functors induce equivalences $\mathfrak{KK}(X)_{\mathrm{loc}} \simeq \mathfrak{KK}(Y)_{\mathrm{loc}}$ between Meyer and Nest's localizing subcategories in Kirchberg's ideal-related KK-theory, and $\mathfrak{E}(X) \simeq \mathfrak{E}(Y)$ between the entire categories in Dadarlat and Meyer's ideal-related E-theory.
